entry.title: ToFu: Exploiting and Fuzzing the LLM-Orchestrator–Tool Trust Boundary

link.title: ToFu: Exploiting and Fuzzing the LLM-Orchestrator–Tool Trust Boundary

entry.content: ToFu is a semantics-aware fuzzing framework for LLM agent tools. It derives security checks from tool metadata and a corpus of 74 CWE-guided sanitizers, targeting the trust boundary between an LLM orchestrator and the tools it calls. Applied to 118 open-source MCP servers, ToFu found 253 manually verified vulnerabilities, including path traversal, SSRF, command injection, log injection, and data exfiltration. Crash-based fuzzers detect none of them.

entry.title: CompassLLM: A Multi-Agent Approach toward Geo-Spatial Reasoning for Popular Path Query

link.title: CompassLLM: A Multi-Agent Approach toward Geo-Spatial Reasoning for Popular Path Query

entry.content:
This study tackles the limitations of traditional geo-spatial algorithms by utilizing the spatial reasoning capabilities of LLMs. The CompassLLM framework employs its agents in a two-stage approach: first, identifying paths from existing geo-spatial data, and second, synthesizing novel paths when one doesn’t exist. CompassLLM demonstrates superior performance compared to traditional methods, addressing challenges in dynamic pathfinding scenarios.
The insights gained from this project showcase the transformative potential of LLMs in real-world applications beyond language tasks. We evaluated GPT-4o, GPT-o3-mini and Llama 3.1 8B.

entry.title: A riverbank erosion early warning system (EWS-RE) for braided river: a case of the Brahmaputra–Jamuna

link.title: A riverbank erosion early warning system (EWS-RE) for braided river: a case of the Brahmaputra–Jamuna

entry.content: This study addresses riverbank erosion in the Brahmaputra-Jamuna River, where 60,000 people are displaced annually, by developing a physics-based early warning system achieving 88% spatial accuracy and 88% sensitivity. I led the full-stack development of the EWS-RE web portal (www.ews-re.com) using React.js, Express.js, Firebase, and Google Maps JavaScript API to transform complex 2D hydro-morphological predictions into intuitive, real-time hazard maps. The platform integrates GloFAS seasonal forecasts with six decades of historical data, delivering color-coded erosion warnings across 250 km of river reaches through three core modules: location search, annual erosion alerts, and water level-based risk assessment. Field testing demonstrated 70% overall accuracy in detecting erosion-prone zones. Published in Frontiers in Earth Science, this work demonstrates how modern web technologies can democratize access to critical environmental predictions, bridging advanced geospatial modeling with practical disaster risk reduction for vulnerable communities.

entry.title: Stock Trader: Automated Agent for Stock Trading

link.title: Stock Trader: Automated Agent for Stock Trading

entry.content:
Stock Trader is a machine learning project aimed at building an automated agent for stock trading, trained and tested on data from the Dhaka Stock Exchange.
This project utilized supervised learning models to predict stock price trends and optimized trading decisions based on historical data. Techniques employed include feature engineering, time-series analysis, and backtesting. The system demonstrated the potential for enhanced decision-making in financial markets by integrating algorithmic approaches.

entry.title: Maps ‘n Bags: Itinerary Planning System
entry.content:
Maps ‘n Bags is an itinerary planning system providing trip suggestions, travel tracking, budget management, and travel diaries.
Developed as part of a software development project, this tool integrates modern web technologies including ExpressJS, Material UI, PostgreSQL, Firebase, and Selenium for scraping. It aims to simplify travel management with an all-in-one solution for users.
This project highlights the application of full-stack development and automation in building practical solutions for travel enthusiasts.

entry.title: Creative Production Management: A Production System for Agencies

link.title: Creative Production Management: A Production System for Agencies

entry.content:
Creative Production Management is a production management system designed for creative agencies to streamline workflows and resource allocation.
The system incorporates features like resource management and estimation modules, built with BPMN, Mock UI, ERD, Sequence Diagrams, and State Diagrams. The project emphasizes effective information and system design, providing agencies with a reliable tool to enhance their operational efficiency.
Key contributions include system architecture design and functional prototype development, showcasing skills in system analysis and practical implementation.

entry.title: Withered Away: Old Home Management System

link.title: Withered Away: Old Home Management System

entry.content:
Withered Away is a comprehensive management system for old homes, streamlining administrative tasks and improving service quality for elderly care facilities.
The system was developed using ExpressJS, Material UI, PostgreSQL, and Oracle, later adapted fully to PostgreSQL. It features modules for resident tracking, staff scheduling, and resource management.
This project highlights advanced database management, frontend-backend integration, and practical problem-solving for community-focused solutions.

entry.title: Red Light Green Light: Adaptive Traffic Controller

link.title: Red Light Green Light: Adaptive Traffic Controller

entry.content:
Red Light Green Light is a traffic light controller system designed to adapt dynamically to traffic conditions and train detection.
This project, developed as part of a Microprocessors and Microcontrollers course, utilizes Arduino and sensors to monitor traffic flow and prioritize train crossings. The adaptive system minimizes congestion and improves traffic flow in real-time scenarios.
The project demonstrates hands-on expertise in embedded systems, sensor integration, and adaptive algorithm design for practical applications.
